title: THE FLOOR · UPPER DENSITY, ZERO LEG LOAD
vibe: 45 min · green · upper + midline · no treadmill by design
why: Legs are tired from six laps; today nothing stands on them. First card through the movement gate: 11 movements, 9 of them under 25% lifetime use.
